open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation / M26 EffectAttempt.authority
open_points.text: "the authority is named by its identity: an approval or a grant by its minted id, a flow activation by its position in the store's order (M18)"
open_points.question: What concrete, stable identifier of a FlowActivation must be stored and referenced by EffectAttempt authority?
options: Use an explicit flow_activation_id field on M18 (minted or derived) and reference it from M26
Use the store commit/order index as the only identifier and expose/persist that index
Use a composite reference such as (flow_version_id, activated_at)
open_points.default_guess: Use the store order index as the activation identity because M26 already points to "position in the store's order".

open_points.subject: Inspect/read of M22 SpooledFile bytes by agent vs owner
open_points.text: State 0 inspect action: "to an agent, personal-data values only as digest and class"; M22: "read by ... the owner inspecting its bytes ... while its run holds its spool"
open_points.question: May an agent ever read spooled file bytes (for non-personal-data files), or are file bytes owner-only regardless of disclosure class?
options: Owner-only file-byte reads for all classes
Agent may read non-personal-data file bytes, with personal_data restricted to digest/class
Agent never reads bytes from spool/traces; only metadata/digests
open_points.default_guess: Treat spooled file bytes as owner-only, since M22 names only the owner for byte inspection.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval creation semantics
open_points.text: "approval_id: minted at random by the kernel when the approval is requested"
open_points.question: What exact event creates a requested EffectApproval record, and can more than one requested/approved record exist for the same node/map element across retries or request_digest changes?
options: Auto-create one EffectApproval each time execution reaches a send that requires approval; each new send attempt/request_digest gets a new approval entity
Create at most one approval entity per node/map_index in a run and mutate it across retries
Create approval only when owner opens/acts on a waiting item rather than when run first blocks
open_points.default_guess: Auto-create an approval record when the run blocks for owner approval, and create a new one for each new send attempt/request digest.
